title: Orange Infused American Chocolate Skillet
description: A sour and chewy one-pot American dish featuring orange juice and tempering chocolate, perfect for those with onion and garlic sensitivities. This dessert is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, granulated sugar, and brown sugar.
Add the melted butter, orange juice, and vanilla extract to the bowl and stir until combined.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler and let it cool slightly.
Add the melted chocolate to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Press the dough into a 10-inch cast iron skillet.
Bake the skillet for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly gooey.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Slice the skillet into wedges and serve warm.
